Exactly 5 masters plus README: Organization, Rules, Agents, Skills, Filetype. One tab per master.
Structure is BAM 0.2: its column names, column order and 3 header rows are kept exactly.

Both originals stay untouched. This is a new file.
Owner instruction [Inherited source claim; owner approval not independently verified for this review.]
Filetype keeps all 43 file types, unchanged and frozen. No columns added to that tab.
Capture only relevant columns, not all report data. Admin holds critical info once a file loads.
Files are not duplicated. Store S3 / Postgres / DuckDB pointers only.
Consistent naming across tabs: row labels 'Unit/Rule/Agent/Skill #n', stable IDs written inside the row.
Owner instruction [Inherited source claim; owner approval not independently verified for this review.]
Description / stable-key rows copied from template tabs are not data rows and are not carried over.

Status is kept inside Misc cells. Nothing here is Approved, all content is Proposed or Illustrative.
Intent classes and routing are proposals. Jev/Laya accuracy is untested on our files. Percentages in section 6 are estimates, not measured.

sheets.name: Filetype
descriptions: How the RAG ingests the input documents

values: Expose native application, embedded and manufacturing-software logic and dependencies that plain text chunking would miss.

Prebundle a C/C++ parser such as tree-sitter/Clang tooling: extract namespaces, classes, functions, includes, symbols and call/include relationships; convert to structured metadata before Cognee graph ingestion and OKF provenance mapping.
Turn operational email into searchable decisions, approvals, requests, handoffs and actor relationships while preserving message-level provenance.

Cognee supports .eml through its document loader. Extract message headers, participants, timestamps, subject, body and attachments; model sender/recipient/thread relationships before graph ingestion. Map original message/resource and extracted claims into OKF sources for provenance.
Capture service, CLI, infrastructure and backend workflow logic written in Go, including package-level relationships.

Prebundle Go parser/AST tooling: extract packages, structs, interfaces, functions, imports and call/dependency relationships; serialize to structured metadata, ingest into Cognee, and retain repository/file source references in OKF.
Capture application and automation logic, API clients, workflow code and module dependencies from JavaScript codebases.

Prebundle a JavaScript/ESTree-compatible AST parser: extract functions, classes, imports/exports, calls and comments; serialize symbols/edges to structured JSON or Markdown, then ingest into Cognee and preserve repository/file provenance for OKF.
Configuration, API payloads, BOMs, manifests and machine-generated metadata where key/value structure should become graph context.

Cognee TextLoader supports JSON. Parse JSON structurally first when keys/arrays encode domain entities; retain object paths and IDs, then ingest normalized text/records into Cognee. OKF can reference the source resource and record provenance/trust signals for generated concepts.
Knowledge-base pages, engineering docs, runbooks, ADRs and other already-structured human/agent-readable context; ideal bridge into OKF.

Ingest directly with Cognee TextLoader. Preserve headings, lists, links and code blocks as semantic structure; chunk/embed/graph in Cognee. Markdown is also the native body format for an OKF concept, with YAML frontmatter carrying type, resource, sources, generated/verified, status and freshness signals.
Extract enterprise context from Outlook messages: decisions, approvals, escalations, commitments and participant relationships.

Use Cognee's document loader with the docs extra, or a prebundled MSG extractor where Outlook-specific properties/attachments need higher fidelity. Normalize sender/recipients/time/subject/body/attachments, then ingest into Cognee and preserve source identity in OKF.
Recover executable workflow logic, business rules, agent/tool implementations and dependencies from Python repositories instead of treating code as undifferentiated text.

Prebundle a Python AST parser before Cognee: extract modules, classes, functions, signatures, imports, docstrings and call/dependency relationships into structured text/JSON; ingest those artifacts into Cognee and link source paths as provenance in OKF.
Recover database structure, lineage and governed calculation logic; especially useful for enterprise analytics and workflow dependencies.

Preparse SQL as DDL/query syntax: extract schemas, tables, columns, constraints, joins, referenced objects and statements. Send schema/lineage metadata to Cognee rather than only raw SQL text; represent sanctioned computations in OKF as Attested Computation when applicable.
Runbooks, SOPs, requirements, notes and logs that are already textual; lowest-friction source for entity, relationship and procedural-context extraction.

Use Cognee TextLoader to normalize UTF-8/plain text directly. Preserve filename, MIME type, extension and content hash; then chunk/embed/graph with Cognee. Emit selected enterprise concepts as OKF Markdown with YAML frontmatter and source provenance.
System configuration, integrations, structured BOM/engineering metadata and XML-based enterprise interchange formats.

Cognee TextLoader supports XML, but preparse XML trees when hierarchy/attributes are meaningful. Convert elements, attributes, IDs and references into structured records before graph ingestion; retain original resource and source metadata in OKF.
Configuration, CI/CD, infrastructure, manifests and API/tool definitions where hierarchy and keys carry workflow meaning.

Cognee TextLoader supports YAML. Parse mappings/lists/anchors structurally where configuration semantics matter, normalize to deterministic JSON/text for Cognee, and retain the original file as an OKF source/resource.
Give FDE agents context about available MCP tools, their schemas, capabilities and where each tool fits in an enterprise workflow.

Parse MCP/FastMCP server declarations and tool metadata into server, tool, input-schema, output and resource/prompt relationships; ingest the normalized manifest into Cognee and expose tool concepts/resources through OKF references.
High-fidelity PCB manufacturing context for FDEs: board structure, connectivity, components and fabrication/assembly data beyond natural-language documents.

Prebundle an ODB++ archive/parser: unpack the job, extract layer stack, nets, components, drill/rout, materials and manufacturing attributes into normalized JSON. Ingest the structured engineering entities/relationships into Cognee and attach job/source provenance through OKF.
Give FDE agents machine-readable knowledge of enterprise APIs, contracts, payloads, authentication requirements and service relationships.

Parse OpenAPI JSON/YAML deterministically before Cognee: extract paths, operations, parameters, request/response schemas, security schemes and component references as entities/edges. Ingest structured output into Cognee; publish API concepts in OKF with resource/source links and lifecycle metadata.
Understand legacy API contracts and map operations to services, data objects and integration workflows.

Parse Swagger/OpenAPI 2.0 definitions into endpoints, HTTP methods, parameters, definitions, responses and security metadata; normalize to structured JSON/Markdown before Cognee and retain the specification URI as OKF provenance.
Bring public/internal web documentation, wiki pages, product docs and web-based runbooks into the enterprise context graph while retaining source URLs.

For a webpage URL, Cognee fetches HTML and extracts text with its URL crawler; direct binary-file URLs should be downloaded by the ingestion gateway first rather than passed as webpage URLs. Normalize page text/metadata, ingest into Cognee, and store the canonical resource URL in OKF frontmatter/sources.
Flat master data, exports, mappings and transactional extracts such as Part Number→Supplier or Customer→Account relationships.

Cognee auto-detects CSV and can ingest it via dlt; schema and foreign-key relationships can be built deterministically without LLM extraction. Infer/declare headers and types, preserve row/source identifiers, then graph domain entities; expose resulting concepts and sources in OKF.
Enterprise policies, SOPs, proposals, requirements and reports authored in Microsoft Word.

Use Cognee UnstructuredLoader with cognee[docs]. Extract headings, paragraphs, tables, lists and document metadata to normalized text while preserving hierarchy; ingest into Cognee and retain the original document as OKF provenance.
Large analytical datasets and event/transaction exports where columnar schema and selected records provide enterprise context efficiently.

Use DuckDB/PyArrow to inspect schema and selectively read columnar rows; derive table/field metadata and domain relationships without converting the entire file to prose. Feed structured summaries/entities to Cognee; publish source URI/schema provenance through OKF.
Contracts, manuals, reports, specifications and procedures where text is embedded and page/layout context may matter.

Use Cognee PyPdfLoader for standard extraction or AdvancedPdfLoader with cognee[docs] when layout/tables matter. Preserve page/source metadata, normalize extracted text, then chunk/embed/graph. Generate OKF concepts with the PDF URI in resource/sources and trust/freshness fields as needed.
Portable bundles of repositories, logs, datasets or engineering artifacts that must be unpacked before semantic processing.

Decompress at the ingestion gateway, record archive manifest/path/hash, then route every contained file through its format-specific parser. Ingest extracted content into Cognee with archive→member relationships; carry archive/member resources into OKF sources for provenance.
Operational workbooks, BOMs, cost sheets, trackers and master data where row/column structure, formulas and sheet relationships are business context.

Use Cognee's document loader for workbook extraction, but prebundle openpyxl/structured table extraction for enterprise fidelity: enumerate sheets, named ranges, headers, formulas and cell tables; route heavy calculations to deterministic code, ingest entities/relationships into Cognee, and preserve workbook/sheet provenance in OKF.
Common enterprise delivery package for documents, datasets, code and engineering files containing mixed formats.

Decompress at the ingestion gateway, preserve archive/member paths and hashes, then dispatch each member to the appropriate Cognee loader or prebundled parser. Model archive→member relationships and retain both levels as OKF provenance.
Collaborative enterprise documentation, meeting notes, policies and evolving runbooks that need a stable graph representation with source traceability.

Use Google Drive/Docs API to export document content to Markdown/text with headings, lists, tables, comments/metadata as permitted; feed the normalized export to Cognee. Store the canonical Drive resource URI and source metadata in OKF rather than treating the exported copy as the authoritative identity.
Collaborative trackers, operational masters, planning sheets and lightweight databases where tabular relationships matter.

Use Google Sheets API to read sheets, ranges, formulas and typed values; normalize each logical table with workbook/sheet/range identifiers before Cognee. Use deterministic processing for calculations and preserve the canonical spreadsheet URI/range as OKF provenance.
Native AutoCAD engineering drawings where geometry, layers, annotations and title-block metadata define manufacturing/project context.

Use a CAD-specific parser/converter before Cognee. Extract layers, blocks, entities, title block, annotations and embedded BOM references into structured JSON/text; do not rely on generic image ingestion for engineering semantics. Graph parts/layers/documents and preserve drawing revision/source in OKF.
Exchange-format CAD drawings where vector entities and layer semantics need deterministic extraction before semantic graphing.

Parse DXF sections/entities/layers/blocks with a CAD library such as ezdxf/LibreDWG; extract title-block text, dimensions, annotations and entity relationships into JSON before Cognee. Preserve file/revision provenance in OKF.
Legacy neutral 3D CAD exchange used to expose product geometry and part/assembly context to FDE workflows.

Use a 3D CAD/STEP-IGES geometry parser such as Open CASCADE to extract product/assembly names, topology, bounding boxes and available attributes; serialize engineering metadata to JSON/text before Cognee and preserve model/source revision in OKF.
Photos, screenshots, scanned pages, labels, diagrams and visual evidence requiring semantic description or OCR.

Cognee ImageLoader uses a vision-capable LLM to describe images. For enterprise ingestion, add OCR/layout extraction when text/tables are present; store extracted description/text plus image metadata in Cognee and keep the original image resource as OKF provenance.
Photos, screenshots, scanned records and diagrams that carry enterprise context unavailable as native text.

Cognee ImageLoader uses a vision-capable LLM to describe images. Add OCR/layout extraction for text-heavy images, normalize captions/text/objects for graph ingestion, and retain image identity/source in OKF.
Calls, interviews, meetings and field recordings where spoken decisions, requirements and entities need to become searchable context.

Cognee AudioLoader transcribes audio with a Whisper-compatible model. Add timestamps/speaker segmentation when available, normalize transcript segments and metadata, then ingest into Cognee; retain recording URI and generated/verified provenance in OKF.
Training videos, inspections, demos and recorded workflows where both spoken and visual context matter.

Preprocess video with audio transcription plus scene/keyframe segmentation; run OCR/vision on relevant frames, align transcript and visual events by timestamp, then ingest normalized segments into Cognee. Preserve original video/time ranges as OKF sources.
Scanned contracts, invoices, drawings, legacy records and signed documents that cannot be reliably indexed through text extraction alone.

Detect pages with no usable text layer; rasterize pages and run OCR/vision extraction before Cognee. Preserve page number, bounding/layout references and OCR confidence where available; normalize extracted text/tables and retain the original PDF/page as OKF source provenance.
Screenshots, diagrams, schematics, dashboards and scanned forms used as evidence or workflow context.

Cognee ImageLoader can describe PNGs with a vision-capable LLM. Add OCR/layout/table extraction for screenshots, schematics and scanned forms; ingest extracted text/objects/relations and preserve image source metadata in OKF.
Neutral 3D CAD exchange for manufacturing/aerospace/automotive workflows requiring assembly and part context.

Parse STEP with a 3D geometry kernel such as Open CASCADE; extract assembly tree, product/part names, geometry metadata, bounding boxes and available properties into structured JSON before Cognee. Preserve model/revision source in OKF.
Alternate STEP extension used for neutral 3D CAD exchange and assembly/part context.

Treat as STEP content: parse with a 3D geometry kernel, extract assembly/product structure, part names, bounding boxes and attributes, serialize to JSON/text, then ingest into Cognee with model/revision provenance in OKF.
High-resolution scans, archival documents, engineering images and document-imaging workflows.

Use image/OCR preprocessing before Cognee. For multipage TIFF, preserve page/frame boundaries; extract text, tables and visual descriptions, then ingest normalized artifacts and retain page-level source provenance in OKF.
Meetings, calls, voice notes and machine/field recordings where speech provides enterprise workflow context.

Cognee AudioLoader transcribes WAV with a Whisper-compatible model. Preserve timestamps and audio metadata; optionally add diarization, then ingest transcript segments into Cognee and keep the recording URI as OKF source provenance.
Legacy PCB fabrication artwork requiring deterministic vector parsing before it can contribute manufacturing context.

Use a Gerber parser before Cognee to decode apertures, flashes, draws, regions and coordinates; combine copper/mask/silkscreen layers plus drill data into a structured PCB manifest. Graph layers/nets/features and retain job/layer provenance in OKF.
PCB fabrication data with richer standardized attributes than RS-274X, improving layer/component semantics for FDEs.

Parse Gerber X2 commands plus file/aperture attributes; extract layer function, component/pad attributes and geometry into a structured PCB manifest before Cognee. Preserve layer/job provenance and revision signals in OKF.
Newer Gerber-based PCB manufacturing context where component data should be available to engineering agents.

Parse Gerber X3 including component information in addition to X2-style attributes and geometry; normalize layers, components, pads and manufacturing features into JSON before Cognee and preserve source/revision provenance in OKF.
Comprehensive PCB design-to-manufacturing exchange that can supply richer assembly/fabrication context than rendered documents.

Parse the IPC-2581 XML package deterministically: extract stackup, materials, components, nets, BOM, fabrication and assembly attributes; map IDs/references into graph relationships before Cognee. Preserve package/revision provenance in OKF.

notes: Note: Should be private table. FDE should not be able to edit.
